saturdays of november 6pm: maureen lee sundays of november 10am: maeve fallon all saints day, 1st nov. focus: the saints model christian holiness & pray for us from heaven. - like those in revelation whose robes have been washed … in the blood of the lamb, the saints come from every nation & have followed christ in every christian vocation. we are called to follow christ’s example & live the beatitudes. the saints give us a model of this holiness so that we might also praise god for all eternity. priesthood in achonry diocese – it is worth saying “yes” to god: for more information contact achonry diocesan vocations director, fr paul kivlehan

sympathy: we remember in our prayers at this time: maureen gohery, charlestown & london, (nee wims, achonry, sister of nathy wims). may the souls of the faithful departed rest in peace adoration in mullinabreena church 4-7pm on tuesdays for the month of november. norms for indulgences at the commemoration of all souls from 12 noon on 1 november until midnight on 2 november, the faithful may gain one plenary indulgence, applicable only to the souls of the departed, by: devoutly visiting a church or oratory. reciting there one our father and the apostles’ creed. fulfilling the usual conditions for a plenary indulgence listed below. visit to a cemetery from 1 november to 8 november inclusive, the faithful may gain a plenary indulgence for the holy souls by: devoutly visiting a cemetery & praying for the faithful departed, even if only mentally. fulfilling the usual conditions for a plenary indulgence. this indulgence may be gained once on each day from 1 to 8 november, & is applicable only to the faithful departed. the usual conditions for a plenary indulgence. for either of the above indulgences, the faithful must: go to confession. receive the eucharist. prayer for the intentions of the holy father - one our father & one hail mary, or another suitable prayer. complete detachment from all sin, even venial sin, with a sincere disposition of heart. confession may be made within the week before or after 1 nov., according to the irish norms cited above. holy communion and prayer for the pope's intentions are ordinarily undertaken on the day the indulgenced work is performed. world mission sunday supports missionaries & communities in need & hope for a better future. a sincere thank you to everyone who has already contributed so generously €748. your kindness makes a real difference to the lives of those most in need. if you have not yet had an opportunity to contribute, there is still time to do so. every donation, however small, is greatly appreciated & helps support the church’s mission around the world. 25 drive: in st nathy’s hall every friday at 8:30pm three hills café (beside mullinabreena church) café is open saturday & sunday 10am-2pm. thank you for your continued support. book swap / sale every sunday 2-4pm in carrowmore school. social club: the knocknashee inn social club is now open thursdays 6pm -
